# Set-up

This markdown prepares the Lung Cancer dataset for analysis. The dataset was downloaded from the [10X Genomics website](https://www.10xgenomics.com/datasets/20k-mixture-of-nsclc-dtcs-from-7-donors-3-v3-1-with-intronic-reads-3-1-standard). The files downloaded are 

- the filtered feature_bc_matrix.h5 files per sample 

- CMO config file

- raw feature_bc_matrix.h5 file (all samples)

- multiplexing results file 

To generate a dataset with ground-truth doublet labels (based on CMO counts), we need to export a `cellranger` like output strucutre that contains both singlets and doublets. Currently, the doublets are filtered out from the filtered output matrix and hidden in the raw `h5` file.

## Load data

```{r}
# load raw counts
counts_raw <- Read10X_h5(here("data/LungCancer_10x/20k_NSCLC_DTC_3p_nextgem_intron_Multiplex_count_raw_feature_bc_matrix.h5"))$`Gene Expression`

#load per sample filtered counts
samples <- paste0("donor_", 1:7)
list_barcodes <- lapply(samples, function(sample){
  file_in <- sprintf("%s/20k_NSCLC_DTC_3p_nextgem_intron_%s_count_sample_feature_bc_matrix.h5",  here("data/LungCancer_10x"), sample)
  counts <- Read10X_h5(file_in)$`Gene Expression`
  barcodes <- colnames(counts) %>% as.data.frame()
  rm(counts);gc()
  return(barcodes)
})
names(list_barcodes) <- samples
all_barcodes <- list_barcodes %>% bind_rows(., .id="Sample") %>%
  dplyr::rename(Barcode=".")

#load multiplexing results
CMO_information <- read_csv(file = here("data/LungCancer_10x/20k_NSCLC_DTC_3p_nextgem_intron_Multiplex_multiplexing_analysis_tag_calls_per_cell.csv"), show_col_types = F)

```


# Inspect CMO results

The following CMOs were assigned:

```{r}
donor_cmo <- data.frame(donor=paste0("donor_", seq(1,7,1)),
           CMO = c("CMO301", "CMO302", "CMO303", "CMO304", "CMO306", "CMO307", "CMO308"))

donor_cmo %>% knitr::kable()
```


What are is the distribution of singlets, doublets and higher order multiplets

```{r}
CMO_information$num_features %>% table()
```


What shall we do with the higher order multiplets? They make up a very small proportion of the whole dataset. 


# Prepare metadata

## Prepare cell metadata

We only have demultiplexing results for cells called by `cellranger`, so that will be our baseline. In addition, we're adding all multiplets, though we will give them different names for now depending on what their occupancy is. 

```{r}
cell_info <- CMO_information %>%
  mutate(., doublet_class = case_when(num_features == 1 ~ "singlet", 
                                      num_features == 2 ~ "doublet",
                                      num_features>2 ~ "multiplet")) %>% 
  select(., cell_barcode, doublet_class) %>%
  dplyr::rename(Barcode = cell_barcode) %>%
  left_join(., all_barcodes) %>% 
  mutate(., Sample = ifelse(is.na(Sample), "CMO_multiplet", Sample))

cell_info %>% head() %>% knitr::kable()
```


## Prepare raw metadata

Make metadata for the raw object as well. This should make it easier later to determine what the background is! 

```{r}
df_raw_meta <- data.frame(Barcode = colnames(counts_raw), 
                          type= NA)

df_raw_meta <- df_raw_meta %>% 
  left_join(., cell_info) %>% 
  mutate(., type = ifelse(is.na(doublet_class), "empty", doublet_class)) %>% 
  select(., Barcode, type)

#export
write_tsv(x=df_raw_meta, file = here("output/data/LungCancer_10x/LungCancer_10x_raw_metadata.tsv"),
          col_names = T)
```


# Prepare `cellranger` output that contains CMO doublets

As the original `cellranger` objects did not contain CMO doublets, we need to make these outputs using the cellinfo we derived above. 

## Filter raw `h5` object

```{r}
#add rownames
rownames(cell_info) <- cell_info$Barcode
cell_info <- cell_info %>% DataFrame() #SCE requirement

#filter data
counts_filtered <- counts_raw[, rownames(cell_info)]

#check order is correct
all(colnames(counts_filtered) == rownames(cell_info))


```

## Make SCE object and add QC metrics

```{r}
#Make SCE
sce <- SingleCellExperiment(assays = c("counts" = counts_filtered), colData =cell_info)
sce <- sce[rowSums(counts(sce) ) > 0,]

#add QC metrics
is.mito <- grepl(pattern = "^MT", rownames(sce))
is.ribo <- grepl(pattern = "^RP[SL]", rownames(sce))
sce <- addPerCellQCMetrics(sce, subsets = list(mito = is.mito, ribo=is.ribo))

#clean up
new_meta <- sce@colData %>% as.data.frame() %>%
  dplyr::rename(.,nfeatures_raw = detected, ncount_raw = sum, subsets_mito_percent_raw = subsets_mito_percent, subsets_ribo_percent_raw=subsets_ribo_percent) %>%
  select(., -c("subsets_mito_sum", "subsets_mito_detected", "total", "subsets_ribo_sum", "subsets_ribo_detected"))
sce@colData <- new_meta %>% DataFrame()
```

## Export 

Export in `cellranger` output format, including metadata.

```{r}
#export counts
output_dir <- here("output/data/LungCancer_10x/LungCancer_10x_cellranger_allmultiplets/")
DropletUtils::write10xCounts(path = output_dir,
                             x = counts(sce),
                             version = "3",
                             overwrite = T)
#and export metadata
write_tsv(x= as.data.frame(sce@colData), file = paste0(output_dir, "metadata.tsv"),
          col_names = T)

```
